recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a mobile-first portrait browser canvas game called "Beetlejuice Ghost Train". Preserve a free-roam trick-jump loop: left joystick accelerates the rider through an open map, coffin-ramp gates launch the rider airborne, three right-side trick buttons can be tapped only while airborne, clean landings bank score, mistimed tricks drop the combo, hazards bump the rider, and a debrief/restart overlay ends and restarts the run. The world should feel like gothic afterlife comedy with striped trickster energy, haunted-house carnival props, grotesque whimsy, slime-green/pumpkin/purple visuals, readable HUD, and touch-friendly controls for 4:7 to 9:16 portrait screens.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
- genre: free-roam canvas arcade exploration with trick-jump scoring
- objective: steer through the open map, hit ramp/gate volumes at speed, perform one of three airborne trick actions, and land cleanly to bank score
- input model: mobile-first virtual joystick on the left for movement; three touch buttons on the right for airborne trick actions; a small debrief/end button and restart CTA
- core loop: accelerate on the ground, collide with a gate/ramp to enter air state, optionally tap a trick while airborne, land before the trick timer expires to score, avoid or rebound off hazards, continue roaming
- fail/friction state: no hard death from hazards; collisions knock the player airborne and can drop a trick/slow momentum; debrief overlay acts as terminal/restart state

## Protected Mechanics
- Preserve joystick movement, acceleration/friction, world bounds, camera follow, gate-triggered air state, hazard bump behavior, trick buttons, combo scoring on safe landing, dropped-trick feedback, score/speed HUD, debrief/restart flow, and mobile touch actionability.

## Remix Direction
The same ride-and-trick loop becomes a gothic afterlife comedy carnival: the player is a striped bio-exorcist beetle rider haunting a house map, coffin ramps launch prank opportunities, grotesque props act as hazards, and clean landings bank mayhem. Presentation, copy, fonts, colors, procedural silhouettes, background motifs, particles, and audio are transformed while mechanics stay intact.
